scope: Continue moving the Oyatie application-shell prototype toward the complete Bominal-grade mockup by deepening Workflow Studio into a local, visibly functional editor surface.
user_direction: $agent-skills:visual-ralph $agent-skills:frontend-ui-engineering make further polishes towardds complete mockup of oyatie
The mockup should use Bominal and the standalone Workflow Editor as references, improve/integrate them, and remain a cohesive product rather than a separate mix of surfaces.
Surfaces should be fully interactive and functional visually, without backend wiring.
implemented: Replaced the Workflow Studio static SVG diagram with a Bominal-style local workflow board composed of draggable node cards, SVG edge paths, visible ports, grid canvas, and a drop hint.
Added SSR-rendered workflow card data attributes so the local JS island can select, drag, connect, inspect, and extend nodes without backend wiring.
Added local drag movement for workflow nodes, including live edge-path recomputation and status-bar feedback.
Added local palette drag/drop and Add block behavior that creates visual workflow cards, node toolbar entries, inspector content, and local edge previews.
Added connect-mode behavior that marks a pending source and previews a local connection to a selected target node.
Added visual zoom control behavior and kept Run/Validate/Publish/Clear states integrated with the board and status chip.
Kept the design language within the existing Bominal-derived Oyatie tokens: flat surfaces, tight radii, dense controls, mono metadata, and restrained accent color.

verification.details: HTML includes workflow-board, data-workflow-card, workflow-board-edge, canvas-drop-hint, and data-workflow-palette-search.

Confirmed initial workflow cards, Add block creates local card, inspector updates, drag changes card position, connect mode preserves/adds edge network, zoom label changes, and Run preview state applies.
Captured workflow-board, interacted workflow-board, and command palette screenshots.

visual_verdict.category_match: Cohesive Oyatie Workflow Studio with Bominal-style dense editor chrome and local visual interactivity.
improvements_over_previous_pass: The workflow editor is now a local interactive board rather than a static SVG line of nodes.
Node cards can be visually dragged, inspected, added from the palette, connected in preview mode, zoomed, and run as a simulation preview.
The result is closer to the standalone workflow editor reference while remaining embedded in the cohesive Oyatie control center.
remaining_differences: Still not full parity with Bominal standalone editor: no persisted document model, true pan canvas, real port-to-port drag connection, editable field inspector, context menu, undo stack, or multi-run history.
Workflow additions and connections are local DOM previews; Leptos state and backend workflow engine are intentionally not wired.
The broader Oyatie mockup still needs deeper routed Messenger, Mail, Community, settings, identity, notification, and analytics pages before complete-product status can be proven.

non_claims: No backend integration, real authentication/authorization, production tenant data, PHI/PII, external message/mail/community send, real workflow execution, or real cloud provider operation is claimed.
No production readiness, measured SLO, DR, compliance certification, provider-live operation, or hyperscaler readiness is claimed.
Bominal remains a visual/product reference; the implementation is repo-native Rust/Leptos/CSS/JS and intentionally not copied as-is.
